title: Configurable page size for expense listing
pr_description: Lets API callers choose a page size when listing expenses and adds a page_count helper so clients can render pagination controls.

defects.description: page_count is off by one when the total is an exact multiple of the page size: 40 items at 20 per page reports 3 pages. Should be ceil division, e.g. (total + page_size - 1) // page_size, with the zero-items case handled.
page_size is never validated. In SQLite, LIMIT -1 means 'no limit', so a caller passing page_size=-1 dumps the user's entire table in one response; 0 or huge values are also accepted silently.
